resources.string: Pen Scroll only performs a single swipe gesture on the screen when you trigger \"Scroll Down\" or \"Scroll Up\" (for example from S Pen Air actions). It does not read, store or send any screen content. If you turn on the volume-key option, it also turns volume up/down into scrolls while Instagram is open.
Turn on Pen Scroll in Accessibility settings
Battery optimization: enabled, Samsung may kill the service
Volume keys scroll Instagram (overrides volume keys while Instagram is open)
Tap a test button, then switch to Instagram within 3 seconds.

1. Install the APK.

2. Android 13+ blocks Accessibility for sideloaded apps. Go to Settings > Apps > Pen Scroll > three-dot menu (top right) > "Allow restricted settings".

3. Settings > Accessibility > Installed apps > Pen Scroll > turn on.

4. Settings > Apps > Pen Scroll > Battery > Unrestricted (so Samsung doesn't kill it).

5. Settings > Advanced features > S Pen > Air actions > Press and hold Pen button > choose "Scroll Down".

6. If the gesture slots under Anywhere actions accept apps, assign one to "Scroll Down" and one to "Scroll Up".
